items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: You know old man Claymore Williams?

ctx.x: Well, you know John Pendleton. Yes. John Pendleton. He used to play trombone. Trumpe. He used to play trumpe?
Yes. There's a whole lot of like... I speak like two-row. Two-row was a... You know old man Claymore Williams? You getting any information on him at all?
Yes, we've heard people up at Donaldsonville.
